one_liner: Modern open-source CRM platform with extensibility as code, REST/GraphQL APIs, and a native MCP server for AI assistants.
access_notes: Cloud self-serve signup with free trial; create API keys under Settings → Developers → API; OAuth flows available without partner review.
blocker_notes: After the free trial, Cloud is paid; self-host remains free if users run their own instance.

evidence.quote: Start your free trial today without credit card.
Read and write records over REST and GraphQL, get webhooks when records change, and connect apps with OAuth.
Cloud | https://api.twenty.com/ … Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY … For OAuth-based access (external apps acting on behalf of users), see OAuth.
Every Cloud workspace ships with a native MCP server. Connect your AI assistant via OAuth and it can read and write your CRM data in natural language.
There is no static API reference… each workspace has its own schema,
# Add a new remote (opens a browser for OAuth login)… Add a remote non‑interactively… --api-key $TWENTY_API_KEY … Your credentials are stored in ~/.twenty/config.json.
